requirements.title: Web UI dashboard
requirements.description: Visual diff viewer, interactive staging, branch management, service health monitoring

requirements.title: Review arbitrary captured phases and typed evidence without phase-specific UI code
requirements.description: The review surface renders run-captured descriptors dynamically; Screenshots and Workflows discover artifacts by evidence kind across every producer phase; unknown kinds retain a safe fallback; navigation contains exactly Overview, Baselines, Metrics, Screenshots, Workflows, Tests, AI Changes, and Agent, with Rules and Code Quality absent.

validation.notes: Preserves unknown descriptor and artifact metadata, filters captured descriptor metadata, and discovers kinds across arbitrary producer phases.
Rejects fixed Test Genie phase keys and producer-phase comparisons in the generic production boundary.

Proves screenshots and workflow media render from unknown producer phases through opaque IDs; media bytes remain deferred until Preview; unknown and legacy kinds retain metadata, provenance, relationships, authorized actions, and missing-byte states; visual diffs remain advisory; Agent and exact Tests navigation preserve run/phase/artifact identity.
Pins the exact eight retained tabs and rejects removed Rules and Code Quality URL state.

Exercises descriptor-driven attention grouping, provider/class/dimension/maturity filters, historical selection, lazy opaque artifacts, zero-phase and legacy degradation, and bounded rendering for a 50-phase catalog.
Exercises single-run baseline identity, dynamic outcome counts, stale/dirty/catalog-change indicators, comparison reasons, and collapsed clean phases without a phase registry.
